contexts.text: The celestial man is the seventh day... AC 84.
Therefore the seventh day was sanctified.
Cain... avenged sevenfold () = that it would be sacrilege; for seven = what is sacred. AC 433.

The septenary number was held sacred on account of... the seventh day, which is the celestial man... Hence the septenary number so often occurs... and intervals of time were distinguished into sevens, and were called weeks. Illustrated. AC 433.
The septenary number, in the Word, everywhere = something holy or sacred as to the states which the times or other things involve.
Of every clean beast seven, seven (). Explained.
Seven = holy things; for the Lord is the seventh day, and, from Him, every celestial Church, or man, nay, the Celestial itself... Hence seven, in the Word, = what is holy... AC 716:2, Illustrated.
Seven is predicated of voluntary things.
Seven = holy things; here, holy truths, which... come from goods.
In seven days () = the beginning of temptation... and also the end of vastation. AC 753. AC 1670.
For seven is a holy number, and = the Lord's advent into the world, and His advent into glory; and every advent of His in particular. Explained, Illustrated.
The times are still more sacredly and certainly designated by (these) septenary numbers.
Seven days () the beginning of visitation.
Seven months () = the last limit of vastation, the first of visitation.
Seven times shall pass over him () = the end of vastation, and the beginning of a new man.
(Thus) in seven days = the beginning of a new Church, and the end of the old one.
Seven, in the Word, = what is holy. AC 881. AC 900. AC 2832:7. AC 2905. AC 3325:8. AC 4670:end. AC 5198.
The spiritual man (also) after temptations, becomes... not the seventh day, like the celestial man, but the seventh month. AC 852.
He waited yet other seven days () = the beginning of a third state. Explained.
See Last Judgment.
When seven occurs, instead of seven what is holy comes to the Angels; for seven = what is holy from the fact that the celestial man is the seventh day, or Sabbath.
Under Fifty, see this reference.
Abraham's seven ewe lambs () = the holiness of innocence.
Under Beersheba, see this reference.
I will serve thee seven years () = study, and then a holy state. Explained. AC 3845.
A way of seven days () = what is holy of truth.
Seven times () = of the highest degree.
Seven = what is holy; and also involves a whole period from beginning to end. References. AC 6540.
That seven = holy things, is from the signification of numbers in the World of Spirits...
Seven, in the supreme sense, = the Divine itself; and, in the representative sense, the Celestial of love...
Seven, in the opposite, = what is profane.
That seven = both holy and profane things. Illustrated.
Seven years () = the first states. AC 5340.
The seven daughters () = the holy things of that Church.
Seven days () = an entire period from beginning to end; thus a full state.
Seven days () = what is holy.
Until the seventh day () = a full holy state. AC 8058. AC 8059.
In the seventh day () = the end of the state.
Seven days () = the entire period of this, state.
Conjunction is signified by the seventh day.
Why no manna on the seventh day.
On the seventh day () = a state of conjoined good and truth. AC 8507. See AC 8889.
Hence the seventh day () = a holy state.
Rested on the seventh day () = then peace and the good of love. The seventh day = a state of celestial love; and thence what is holy, References. AC 8894.
The seventh year () = a state of the conjunction of good and truth; (here) a state of confirmed truth. Explained.
Seven years () = a full state, thus to the full.
Seven days () = the first state of those being regenerated; for seven = from beginning to end, thus what is full. AC 9228, Fully illustrated.
The light of the sun sevenfold, as the light of seven days () = a full state of intelligence and wisdom from love and faith. AE 257:6. AE 401:10.
In the seventh year thou shalt let the land rest () = the second state when man is in good. Explained.
This (second state of regeneration) is meant by the seventh day, the seventh year, and the jubilee.
The seventh day = that when man is in internals, then, being in Heaven with the Lord, labour and combat cease, and he is in the tranquillity of peace, in which also conjunction is effected.
On the seventh day thou shalt cease [from work] () = a state of good when in internals, and the tranquillity of peace then. Explained.
Seven days () = a holy state.
To bear seven () = to be regenerated to the full.
In the seventh day () = when truth has been conjoined with good.
Its seven lamps () = the holy spiritual things thence.
Seven days () = a full state, thus what is plenary. AC 10120. AC 10127.
Both seven, and three = what is full; but seven is said where holy things are treated of. AR 505:2. AE 20.
In the seventh day () = a state of good, which is the end.

In the seventh day He rested and breathed () = a state of good when the Church has been instaurated, or when man has been regenerated; for the seventh day = a holy state... In the supreme sense, the seventh day = the union of the Divine Itself and the Divine Human... Hence seven = what is holy.
Seven days () = a holy state from the appropriation of Divine truth... For seven days = a state holy from beginning to end.
In the seventh day () = the second state of regeneration, when man has conjunction with the Lord; and, in the supreme sense, the union of the Human with the Divine Itself.

The seven Churches () = all in the Christian world... for seven = all things and all persons; and, thence, what is full and perfect; and it is said in the Word where holy, or profane, things are being treated of; and therefore this number involves what is holy, or profane. Illustrated.
The seven Spirits () = all in Divine truth; in the abstract, Divine truth itself. AR 155.
Seven candlesticks () = the New Church. AE 62.
Seven stars () = all Knowledges of good and truth. AR 155. AE 184.
The seven lamps... are the seven Spirits of God () = the New Church... through the Divine Truth.
Seven seals () = completely hidden. Seven = all, thus completely. AE 300.
Seven horns () = omnipotence. Seven = all. AE 316.
Seven eyes () = omniscience. Seven = all, and is said of a holy Thing. AE 317.
Seven Angels () = the universal Heaven. Seven = all, or all things; and thence the whole and universal. AR 657.
Seven thunders () = (a full disclosing and manifestation); for seven = all, all things, and the whole.
The voice of the seventh Angel () = the final exploration and manifestation.
Seven = all and all things, and is predicated of the holy things of Heaven and the Church; and in the opposite, of these profaned.
The seventh Angel sounded () = the exploration and manifestation of the state of the Church after consummation, when there is the Lord's advent and Kingdom. Explained. AE 681, Explained.
Seven heads () = insanity from truths falsified and profaned; for seven is predicated of profane things. AR 724. AR 737.
The seventh day is for the Lord...
The seventh day = man's conjunction with the Lord, and, thereby, regeneration.
On the seven mountains of Babylonia. Explained.

Seven, in the Word, = beginning and end, thus an entire period, and a full state; and therefore all, because all make what is full... and therefore where magnitude is treated of, seven = what is full; and where multitude, seven = all. AE 24. AE 62. AE 257, Illustrated.
The seven Spirits of God () = all the truths of Heaven and the Church. AE 274.
The seven Churches = all who are of the Church; in the abstract, all things of the Church.
To forgive seven-times () = all times.
Seven, and seven times = all things, and what is full. Illustrated.
The seven lamps = all truth in the complex.
Seven = all, and what is full, and is predicated of what is holy 336. AE 602.
Seven years = all things, what is full, and altogether.
To bear seven = to be endowed with all the truths of the Church. AE 721:7.
There are simple numbers... 2, 3, 5, and 7; 7 = what is holy. AE 532.
Seven times (to wash) = what is plenary, and is predicated of holy things, such as Divine truths.
The seventh = what is full and consummated, thus the last.
The seven Angels = all the Heavens. AE 500.
Seven (women) = what is holy.
Seven weeks () = a full time and state.

The priests being seven, their going round (Jericho) seven days, and seven times on the seventh day () = what is holy, and the holy preaching of Divine truth; for seven (here) = what is holy on one side, and what is profane on the other.
Seven heads = all knowledge of the holy things of the Word adulterated. AE 775.
Seven diadems = all ultimate Divine truths profaned.
Seven is said of the holy things of the Word and of the Church.
Seven Angels having the seven last plagues () = all Divine truths from the Lord manifesting evils and falsities in the whole complex. AE 949.
The seven heads are seven mountains () = (that the holy things of the Word profaned are the goods of the Word adulterated and profaned).
And are seven kings () = the truths of the Word falsified and profaned.
Seven = the truth of good profaned.
